list.title: Participants
footer.description: Quickly join a game without an account.
footer.helpText:
Create a session: Tap (+) to create a new session. Enter the details manually or paste a message and let Quicky fill them in.
Join a session: Enter your name, select your time slots, and tap Fight! If the session is full, you can join the waitlist.
Share: Copy the session details and share them with your friends.
